mapper.sql: goods_id, user_id, category_id, goods_name, description, price, status, view_count, favorite_count, condition_level, campus, location, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT g.goods_id AS goodsId, g.user_id AS userId, g.category_id AS categoryId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.description AS description, g.price AS price, g.status AS status, g.view_count AS viewCount, g.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, g.condition_level AS conditionLevel, g.campus AS campus, g.location AS location, g.create_time AS createTime, gi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON gi.image_id = ( SELECT image_id FROM goods_image WHERE goods_id = g.goods_id ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order ASC, image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE g.goods_id = #{goodsId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods ( user_id, category_id, goods_name, description, price, status, view_count, favorite_count, condition_level, campus, location, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{goodsName}, #{description}, #{price}, #{status}, 0, 0, #{conditionLevel}, #{campus}, #{location}, NOW() )
mapper.update:
UPDATE goods
category_id = #{categoryId},

WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId}

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods WHERE status = 1) AS goodsCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category_id) FROM goods WHERE status = 1) AS categoryCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(price), 0) FROM goods WHERE status = 1) AS totalPrice

SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(g.price), 2), 0) AS avgPrice, COUNT(g.goods_id) AS goodsCount FROM category c LEFT JOIN goods g ON c.category_id = g.category_id AND g.status = 1 GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY avgPrice DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN price < 50 THEN '0-50元' WHEN price < 100 THEN '50-100元' WHEN price < 200 THEN '100-200元' WHEN price < 500 THEN '200-500元' ELSE '500元以上' END AS priceRange, COUNT(*) AS goodsCount FROM goods WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY priceRange ORDER BY MIN(price)

SELECT g.goods_id AS goodsId, g.user_id AS userId, g.category_id AS categoryId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.description AS description, g.price AS price, g.status AS status, g.view_count AS viewCount, g.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, g.condition_level AS conditionLevel, g.campus AS campus, g.location AS location, g.create_time AS createTime, gi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON gi.image_id = ( SELECT image_id FROM goods_image WHERE goods_id = g.goods_id ORDER BY is_primary DESC, sort_order ASC, image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY g.create_time DESC, g.goods_id DESC
